entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Szob-Nagybörzsöny forest railway is a 760 mm forest railway in Hungary. It runs from Szob to Nagybörzsöny, and was formed by the merger of three separate organisations. The railway is notable for having switch-back operation.
